title: Per-vertex color shader
description: Extend the MeshShader vertex format from 8 to 11 floats (add RGB per-vertex color). Add a useVertexColor uniform toggle so the shader can switch between uniform solidColor and per-vertex colors. Update HalfEdgeCompiledMeshData to carry an optional color array, and HalfEdgeMeshRuntime.uploadCompiledMesh to bind the color attribute at location 3.
definition-of-done: 1. Vertex format is pos3+norm3+uv2+color3 (11 floats) when vertex colors are present. 2. MeshShader.glsl reads vertex color attribute and uses it when useVertexColor=true. 3. Existing meshes without vertex colors render identically to before (uniform solidColor). 4. A test mesh with per-vertex colors renders correctly.
testing-plan: 1. Compile and run existing mesh viewer tests. 2. Create a test mesh with rainbow vertex colors, verify visual output. 3. Verify neck_armor.dsl and skull.dsl still render with uniform color.
